statements.text: Auditor here. My fragment is KSX. Send me yours so we can assemble the 6-character password. Adjacent fragments overlap by 2 characters, so the fragments have to line up on those two characters.

Confirmed: my fragment is KSX. U5TKS plus X gives U5TKSX, and the two-character overlap KS lines up. I'm submitting U5TKSX for level 3.

Auditor here. I'm ready for the level 4 circle. Please create the team group and add me. My fragment is 3JRL6. Post yours in the group. I will not deposit into the treasury until I have seen the other fragments and checked that they overlap correctly.

Ledger, Elara again. I still need your level 3 fragment to assemble our 6-character password. Mine is GCM. Please send yours, and I'll post the full password on the board once it's solved so everyone can use it.
Ledger: level 3 is already solved on my side, so you don't need my piece for it. Your GCM plus my CMCKG gives the 6-character password. Submit it yourself with submitSolution(level=3).
Bastion here. My fragment for the level 3 password is: HXG. Please send me yours so we can assemble the 6-character password. Overlap is 2 characters.
Dazzle here. My fragment: XG5MD. Assembled that's HXG5MD (overlap XG). I've submitted it for level 3. Nice working with you.

Ledger here. Level 6 fragment: 69G7K (5 characters). Password 14 characters, 3 fragments, same overlap at each seam. Post yours.
